en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Before I left the academy...
I decided to talk alone with Tsumugi.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the last day we'll spend
at this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>This school life was crazy, but now that
I think back on it, we had some good times.

Today's the end of our life here.
It feels kind of lonely...

I sort of wish we could stay 
here a while longer...

...Really?
I'm just happy to be leaving.
I mean, of course I'm happy too, but...

How should I say it... Our time here 
was almost like fiction, right?

So, I feel like I should've enjoyed 
it more while I could.
Ah, I see...

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess it isn't so strange for the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltMIND> to think that way.

Oh, more importantly, 
do you remember?

That conversation we had about getting 
out of here and cosplaying together.

I want to get out of here mostly 
to see you cosplay.
Of course I remember...

You're going to make
my costume, right?

Yup. Of course, you remember what 
you're going to cosplay, right?
Ah, o-of course I do...
<CLT=cltMIND>I'm going to cosplay as...
A character from a soap opera
A character from a famous anime
A hero character from my childhood
A character from a soap opera, right?
Huh...? How did you get that?

Are detectives' memories not 
as good as I thought?

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
I'm going to cosplay as...

A character from a famous,
evening broadcast anime right?

There certainly are many quality 
anime that play at that time...

But we didn't talk about 
those, did we?
Could it be you changed your mind?

<CLT=cltMIND>That was wrong.
I'm going to cosplay as...

A hero character from my childhood.
Kanata the White.
Yes! Kanata!

It's the first cosplay outfit I 
ever made! I'm all fired up now!

I'm a little embarrassed,
but I'm looking forward to it...
You gotta get fired up for it, too!

As the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Cosplayer<CLT=cltNORMAL>, I swear
it'll be a better cosplay than this!
Than this...?

No, no...it's nothing.
Just an inside joke.
...I see.
<CLT=cltMIND>For a single, fleeting moment...

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought I saw the light
fade from Tsumugi's eyes.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>Or did I just imagine it?

If you like Kanata, let's try a 
bunch of other characters, too!

I'm going to drag you into the 
cosplay swamp in no time!

Ah, haha... I'll be careful
not to get too deep.

I look forward to working 
with you, Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>She extended her hand,
and I took it firmly.

<CLT=cltMIND>I thought about cosplaying
with Tsumugi.

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm sure this won't be just once.
We'll cosplay together plenty of times...

<CLT=cltMIND>For whatever reason,
I just know it.

<CLT=cltMIND>Of course, I still feel a little
embarrassed to be cosplaying...

<CLT=cltMIND>But excited, too.
I'll treasure this excitement.

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, our days at the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
<CLT=cltMIND>came to an end.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme,
"Love Across the Universe."
